message.content: On April Fool's Day, Wolfgang made a humorous purchase joke involving a set of expensive drums. This was revealed to be an April Fool's prank, as Wolfgang intended it to be a surprise rather than a genuine financial commitment. The joke involved Wolfgang buying a set of expensive drums and jokingly suggesting that he was willing to spend a considerable amount of money on them. This act served as a playful gesture and a light-hearted way to engage with the community.
